   **Bugs and stability.**
      8 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 15, 2026 - Sep 21, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Alexa Reizla_, Sep 18, 2026, 1/5: "Every update breaks yet an other thing. And for the 3rd time I CANNOT open a password protected file 'cause it returns to the main open file screen. With that, after the last 3 updates the performance dropped significantly - it became very slow. Time to switch to something better I guess"
            2. _James Hellriegel Jr._, Sep 21, 2026, 2/5: "I want to love this app but it's buggy. In particular selecting cells (for eventually copy/paste) is a nightmare. Also when connected to Nextcloud it seems impossible to get rid of the dumb warnings that pop up every single time you open a document. Functionally otherwise it's okay but it really falls short of Excel."
            3. _m pe_, Sep 14, 2026, 2/5: "won't properly paste from FUTO keyboard (pinned) & other text items, had to paste in note app them copy again. I appreciate you removed bugs recently but having to constantly make a copy of the document as everything is set to view only even though the file on LO Linux was editable is a recurring pain.No find and replace, couldn't search for case sensitive word.I do appreciate the dark mode though."
